mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_user (email, password, name, role, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{role}, #{active}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password, name, role, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM company_user ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
